name: CISA BOD 23-01 Asset Visibility and Vulnerability Detection
country_or_region: United States federal civilian executive branch
known_limitations: The directive establishes required actions for covered federal assets. It does not disclose agency compliance, inventory completeness, vulnerability closure, contractor execution, or private-sector implementation.
jurisdiction: United States federal civilian executive branch
automation_notes: Track implementation guidance, agency reporting, audit findings, asset coverage, vulnerability detection cadence, and remediation evidence.
notes: Binding Operational Directive 23-01 defines recurring asset-discovery and vulnerability-enumeration requirements for covered federal systems.
